name: Pixel Buds
author: Ryan Doupe
description: Pixel Buds Pro in the bar: per-bud and case battery, listening modes (ANC), and device and sound controls — multipoint, speech detection, on-head detection, volume alerts, EQ, balance — via pbpctrl. Event-driven: the icon appears the moment your buds connect. Requires the pbpctrl AUR package; the popup walks you through installing it.

barWidget.description: Battery per bud and case, listening modes, and an Advanced section with device toggles, EQ, balance and mono. Needs pbpctrl (AUR).

schema.label: Poll interval while the panel is closed (seconds)
Hide the icon while no Pixel Buds are connected
